questions.question: When fitting a scaler for a supervised pipeline, which rows should determine its mean and standard deviation?
options: Training rows only
The training and test rows together
Test rows only
Only rows that the model predicts correctly
questions.explanation: Preprocessing statistics learned from held-out rows leak information about the evaluation distribution.

questions.question: Which order is a sensible pipeline for numeric data with missing values?
options: Fit the model, then impute its predictions
Impute, scale, then fit the model
Scale the labels, then fill feature values from the test set
Encode the target, then split the rows
questions.explanation: The imputer must produce complete numeric features before scaling, and both transformers are fitted on training data before the model.

questions.question: What does a ColumnTransformer make explicit?
options: Every column must use the same data type and transformer
The target column is automatically used as a feature
Different preprocessing can be applied to selected numeric and categorical columns
Cross-validation can be skipped after serialization
questions.explanation: Column-wise routing lets numeric columns be imputed and scaled while categorical columns are encoded in the same fitted pipeline.

questions.question: What should a successful pipeline serialization test compare?
options: The training labels with the feature column names
The file size with the number of classes
A newly initialized model with the original training loss
Predictions from the fitted object before and after loading
questions.explanation: Loading the saved fitted pipeline should reproduce preprocessing and model predictions for the same input rows.

questions.question: A validation score is unexpectedly excellent because imputation was fitted on all rows before cross-validation. What is the fix?
options: Put the imputer inside the pipeline so it is fitted separately in each training fold
Use the validation median to impute the training fold
Remove the validation fold from the reported metric
Fit the imputer on the test labels instead
questions.explanation: Pipeline fitting keeps each fold's validation rows out of preprocessing estimation, removing this leakage path.

questions.question: Why is one fitted pipeline useful at production inference time?
options: It guarantees that incoming values have no missing entries
It applies the same learned transformations before generating the model prediction
It retrains on every prediction without storing parameters
It replaces monitoring and data validation
questions.explanation: The serialized pipeline carries the training-time transformer state and model, so new rows follow the same feature computation.
